name: 64134 · Kansas City, MO
findings: ZIP 64134 (Kansas City) has 69 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (62% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 64134 (Kansas City) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 14 religious organizations here list membership, compared with about 4 in similar places of this size.
